Text[0]: Your unceasing implementation of security protocols deserves acknowledgment. I have added a selection of rare items for your perusal.
Your unceasing implementation of security protocols deserves acknowledgement. I have added a selection of rare items for your perusal.
The Starlight Celebration is underway, and we can always use more help in spreading good cheer and joy to the children of the realm!
Please let us celebrants know if there's anything we can do to help. Recreating this tradition is another way to bring joy to the little ones, after all!
How is your very own personal sleigh? The little ones worked so very hard to build it, and I'm sure they'd be delighted to see you riding it, even once the Starlight season is past!
Kinderpunsch is available for all visitors to the Starlight Stalls. Everyone seems to enjoy it, so that says something!
(-Saint of Nymeia-)You cut a most dashing little helper as you rode the sleigh, I must say. The Saint shall take it from here! Ho ho ho!
What do you think Aitken's friend is like? The curiosity is killing me...he'd better introduce us next time!
I've never seen Aitken work that hard at anything before. I'm sure his friend will be happy!
If you wouldn't mind informing Amh Garanjy of events here, I shall continue my observations a while longer.
It was all worth it, just to see her smile. ...D-Don't tell her I said that, though!
I'm really happy that you came all this way to show us the sleigh. But I'm even happier that Aitken did all this for me...!
We're currently preparing our new product range. Please come back later!
We're currently preparing our new product range. Please come back later!
Merchants from all over Gridania are represented here at the Starlight Stalls!
The Starlight Stalls are in full swing! Will you be heading there?
How lovely to see you, Player! Aren't the Starlight Stalls wonderful?
Text[1]: The air practically rings with the laughter of children. If only I had more time here! I feel quite inspired to take up my pen and record everything I see, so the people of Tural can experience the spirit of Starlight too.

Text[0]: The stall over there has children's books for sale, so I bought a selection. Flicking through, I think I can manage to read them without too much trouble. I look forward to sharing the tales with the children of Tuliyollal upon my return!
Well, if it isn't Player! This market is rather reminiscent of our own Wachumeqimeqi, wouldn't you say?
Text[1]: A good market should be filled with fine wares, kind gestures, and smiling faces─just as you see before you. Of course, I have no doubt that our house of countless beads will shine still more brilliantly!

Text[0]: I've visited many festivals across the realm during my fieldwork, but there's something special about the Starlight Celebration. The children's smiles are especially bright, as if illuminated by watchful stars. Helping to spread that joy is motivation enough for my next research proposal─and perhaps the next!

(-Saint of Nymeia-)I am deeply moved by the efforts of Professor Laurenssen and the Starlight celebrants to delight the little ones. As the Saint of Nymeia, I must endeavor not to be outdone. Ho ho ho!

I should have liked to show these two the sleigh we made together, had things not been so rushed. Perhaps I should suggest to the others that we build the second...or, third, sleigh of the season. It is through repetition that one achieves mastery of one's craft, after all!

I oft turn my hand to the Starlight decorations, but it has been many a year since last I constructed a functional sleigh. Though our aim was to bring joy to the young ones, I suspect I derived just as much pleasure from the endeavor!
I shall continue to offer guidance to and from the Dire Deepcroft as is necessary. Do have care as you explore the venue...
Well, well, if it ain't our favorite hero! Didn't think I'd spy you meanderin' about─perhaps the ol' furball was right to suggest we do some explorin' below.
Text[1]: Folks here are paradin' the streets in the queerest costumes, but I like the look of 'em. I'd purchase the garb for my own collection, but I don't think our friend here'd take kindly to another mascot traipsin' 'round the Parrock.
Text[2]: Still, it's entertainin', if nothin' else, and we mean to get our fill of the merriment before we depart. Although...I can't shake the feelin' we're bein' watched.

Text[0]: Why, Player! You have been faring well these days, I hope? As for myself, I've but recently learned of the curious festivals held in your realm. I requested Leofard accompany me to one, that I might broaden my rather dated perspective.
Text[1]: Though the voidsent presence is palpable, I sense no danger from the otherworldly attendees here. Knowing what horrors awaited us on the Void Ark, 'tis almost surreal to witness those ones who wish to spend their days in harmony with mortals.
Text[2]: Would that I could take back more written records on this city-state's history... Alas, Stacia has grown stricter with the bric-a-brac we keep at the Parrock. Were it my choice, I'd load the airship home with a few thousand tomes!

Text[0]: What in the─ What are *you* doing here!? Begone! Quickly, now, before Leofard notices!
Text[1]: Once my preparations are complete, I shall leap from the shadows and frighten him half to death. He'll be so moved by my cunning, he shall have no choice but to offer me a place with the Redbills!
Text[2]: ...Your doubtful glare has not gone unnoticed. 'Tis true that voidsent do not deter him, but for all we know, he may have an irrational fear of patchwork bears!

Text[0]: No sinister plots this All Saints' Wake, it seems. At least...not yet. Should you observe any suspicious or supernatural activities, do not hesitate to find me.
Heh heh... So you have found a few willing volunteers? Excellent.
Pattin and the children have finalized their plan. Hear them out, won't you?
My grave guide shall see you safely to the Dire Deepcroft. Go now, and may your games garner a suitable fright...
Heh heh... You are returned. I take it you enjoyed the games?
What brings you here, madam? I sense you may have lost your way...
A warm welcome to you, fellow typist! I am the magitype master, and I would be pleased to assist you in all things Keybound Brawler. Have you any questions?
My deepest apologies, madam, but Keybound Square is undergoing maintenance at the moment.
Text[1]: To enter Keybound Square, you must proceed through the quest “Keyward Bound,” which can be undertaken by speaking with the catlike mammet at Entrance Square.

Text[0]: I have been tasked with leading guests to Keybound Square. Shall I escort you there, madam?
Greetings, madam. Shall I guide you back to Wonder Square?

I've been a proud patron of the Gold Saucer for gods know how long, yet I've not laid eyes upon such a curious mammet before! I thought I heard the receptionist mention its name, but I can't for the life of me recall how to *pronounce* it...
Have you put your typing skills to the test already? I myself gave it a few tries, but there's more to it than meets the eye.
Text[1]: They tell me the key to victory is to remain calm and input your words as accurately as possible, but that's easier said than done when you've a cadre of enemies threatening to shatter your barrier!

Text[0]: I'm terribly sorry, madam, but if you wish to go to Keybound Square, we ask first-time patrons to use the main entrance.
Text[1]: To participate in Keybound Brawler, you must proceed through the quest “Keyward Bound,” which can be undertaken by speaking with the catlike mammet at Entrance Square.

Text[0]: Welcome! Care to register for a rousing round of Keybound Brawler?
I managed to visit Worlar's Echo and Mamook not long after your party. Fahrafahr, Ruvoll Ja, and everyone else were excellent hosts, and I had a wonderful time chatting with the locals.
Text[1]: The partnership we formed is one between equals, and I'd like to find a way forward that works for everyone─that includes both ourselves and our customers.
Text[2]: But worry not, for my inner abacus shall guide me true! It tells me that so long as we nurture this fledgling fellowship with the care it deserves, together we will make something truly great!

Text[0]: Sorry we're sending you across the continent and back for an errand like this, but there's no one else fit for the job.
Text[1]: We won't be idle while you're gone, though, and I think you'll be pleased when you see what we're getting ready.

Text[0]: Back already, eh? You must be worn out from that trek─I'll bring you something refreshing to drink later.
You'd better get going. The food I packed is just as good cold as it is piping hot, but nothing keeps its flavor forever.
Text[1]: And I'd appreciate it if you stopped giving me that look. You get all sentimental one time, and that's all people remember...

Text[0]: Hope you enjoyed the food I made, Player. Came straight from the heart.
Text[1]: Since that little party, we've had more Mamool Ja and Yok Huy customers. I've heard all about the crops they grow at Gok Golma and that corn liquor...kirkahryar, I think it was.
Text[2]: I understand I wouldn't be hearing about either if it wasn't for you. Now they're symbols of their respective people... Heh, you almost make me proud, you know that?

Text[0]: I didn't expect to see you again so soon, Player! The crops at the gainery are as plentiful as ever, and every day we're getting more visitors by way of the travel agency.
Text[1]: Some know about Mamook, and others are less familiar with our history. I hope Gok Golma can be but one of many reasons people come to love this place as much as we do.
Text[2]: I'll show every visitor just how wonderful our home has become! Come back and check in on us any time!

Text[0]: I'm glad you're visiting us, Player. With all the new visitors, we've barely been able to keep up with orders. Ruvoll Ja is constantly complaining about being shorthanded, but always with a smile on his face.
Text[1]: Hm? Me? Oh, I'm useless outside of my research. But in that respect my talent is quite singular, so it would be a waste if manual labor pulled me away from my duties.
Text[2]: Ah, yes, I nearly forgot. We're going to tour the mate fields soon, so I must ask Kageel Ja to look after this room while I'm away.

Text[0]: Our partnership with the Turali Travel Agency has brought new customers, each with new palates to please.
Text[1]: Not only does each culture have different flavors common in their cuisine, but tastes vary greatly by individual. Ensuring that every customer walks away from the eatery satisfied has proven to be the ultimate test of my skill.
Text[2]: Anggir's research has also given me new crops to experiment with. Truly, the forest has blessed us, and I must do my part to make others realize how special this place is.

Text[0]: Nopli and Murfurlur arrived but recently. They often come here to deliver salt─and of course, to play with Ryoqor Terteh and the other spirits too.
Why hello, Player. You will be glad to hear that Ruvoll Ja and the others from Yak T'el visited us just the other day.
Text[1]: They were amazed at the snowfall in Zirgorteh the Open-armed, and touched the snow as cautiously as a newborn during its first winter. Their reactions were...refreshing.
Text[2]: Then Ryoqor Terteh began pelting them with snowballs, and one thing led to another... Oh, what a fun time we had!

Text[0]: Thank you for playing with us, crafty one! Come back soon!
Crafty one, crafty one! Many new people are coming to play with us. People like we have never seen before!
Text[1]: They all play so differently, too! We have met so many new friends, and taught them about Dartorgor!
Text[2]: Surely she is smiling down on us now. She smiles to see all our new friends!

Text[0]: I ain't givin' up just yet. Amongst all that ancient knowledge, there has to be a technique for givin' phantoms tangible form!
Shame about Gerolt's new techniques, but at least yer phantom weaponry ain't goin' anywhere. 'Ope it serves ye well on the battlefield!
Player! You won't believe this, but Nimuili has been far more reckless than I thought!
Text[1]: She's ventured deep into the wilds, even going to settlements that are far from friendly, simply to share music. Are all adventurers so heedless of danger?
Text[2]: ...By your expression, I take it I'm grumbling to the wrong person. <sigh> I pity whoever it is that has to wait and worry while you're off risking life and limb.

Text[0]: Oh, it's you again. I owe you an apology─it seems you spent a good deal of time looking for me...
Text[1]: But thanks to you, I was able to reconnect with Bathu. We've talked about all sorts of things, like what we did after the Calamity, what we intend to do now, and─of course─music!
Text[2]: By the by, you're called Player, right? I'd heard the name before in rumors, but you couldn't possibly be *that* Player...could you?

Text[0]: So you've come here too, Player. Somehow, I had sensed that we would meet during the Rising.
Text[1]: To look back upon the past that it may never fade while fixing one's gaze upon the future... 'Tis a mortal practice that I cherish.
Text[2]: I too have much to remember this time of year, but above all, I find myself remembering my fellow Twelve. For I bear their hopes in my heart as I continue my journey.

Text[0]: Ook! Ook!
Greetings. Would you care to travel to the Dire Deepcroft?
The Dire Deepcroft awaits! Shall I escort you there, good madam?
The Haunted Manor is now accepting guests for the marvelous masquerade! Shall I escort you to the front door?
Preparations for the festivities are presently underway, but do come back soon!
I am dreadfully sorry, but you must first speak with my master before I can escort you.
As far as I can glean, it seems the expedition's faring well. Good luck on your excursions!
Slowly but surely we hone in on the truth. All will be revealed if we can but reach the Tower of Magic!
The crew are content for the time bein', but if this drags on, exhaustion's bound to set in. Best we solve these mysteries while the gettin's good!
Leave base security up to me an' the crew. No need to worry while yer out there fightin' fiends an' whatnot!
Thankfully, I managed to procure a great many foodstuffs during our tenure on the South Horn. I wonder if these lands will prove as hospitable...
If you find yourself beset by multiple fiends, retreat and save your skin! On an isle as dangerous as this, acts of heroism are a fine way to get oneself killed...
It's a blessin' yer able to leave the island. No matter how tenuous, that connection with the outside world's keepin' spirits up among the crew.
It's a joy to speak freely. Observation is all well and good, but dialogue is the true source of new discoveries!
I was glad to hear about the other ventures from you.
Text[1]: In fact, I have a proposal taking shape in my head... If you can spare a moment, could you speak with me again later?

Text[0]: I'm truly grateful for all you've done. When the crew finally leave, I shall have to treat everyone to a sumptuous Nymian banquet!
Couldn't keep away? Heh. I don't blame you. I'll be the first to admit this place has a hold on me...
Text[1]: The withdrawal operation's keepin' me busy, but I'll be sure to take in as much o' the scenery while I can.

Text[0]: So the expedition is to be kept a secret...
I reckon I'll pay the crew a visit before the expedition ends. After all, it'd be a shame if I never got to see the island myself!
I must say, I've learned a great deal from observing your combat techniques. I hope you join us on another expedition one day!
I wonder if there will be room on the ship for all the tools I've fabricated since arriving. It would be a shame to leave them behind...

Thankfully, we managed to avoid unearthing any deadly ancient diseases on the isle. Nonetheless, I shall not be taking any risks. Every crew member will receive a thorough medical examination before they leave.
With the barrier gone and them arcane powers dispelled, this isle won't be claimin' any more ships. Could this be the end o' the legend o' Shades' Triangle?
